name: Agent Launcher
author: omarchy.fans
description: Agent Dashboard for Omarchy with Rix, a chief-of-staff agent on your local GPU that manages every agent you spin up (Hermes Agent, OpenClaw; local, Docker, Fly.io Sprite) and hands work to bigger models: API keys, browser sign-in, or vLLM on Modal GPUs you pick. Shows input and output tokens and USD, in total and per task.

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens the persistent Agent Dashboard (right click: quick agent switcher) with a badge when an agent needs you.
